testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (nav links, buttons, inputs, form submits, filter tabs, theme toggle) MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_contrast: Ensure text-slate-100 on dark background (#0B0F19) and text-amber-400 for high-contrast labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Outfit and JetBrains Mono fonts in index.html or index.css.
Implement smooth-scrolling nav anchors for section ids (#services, #capabilities, #case-studies, #why-us, #testimonials, #contact).
Integrate Lucide React icons for tech capabilities (Terminal, Cpu, Database, Server, Workflow, CheckCircle, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, Zap).
Ensure the contact form integrates cleanly with FastAPI/MongoDB backend API endpoint (/api/contact or similar) with loading states and Sonner toast feedback.
Ensure mobile responsiveness with hamburger overlay nav for small screens.
Maintain strict data-testid tags across all buttons, inputs, cards, and links.
